content.english: Noble and awesome is the Glory of El ‘Elyon,
Like the appearance of the rainbow, with its glow in a vision.
Is there not, surrounding it, a great cloud,
And fire flashing, and its glow like a tower?
Its look is like the appearance of ḥashmal, borne by creatures—
Four of them—whose image is that of bodies.
They are formed in the image of a person, with four faces;
The form is one, but the faces are different.
With four wings, touching, to cover
Their bodies; and they have six.
Stretched out over their heads is a firmament, like the appearance of awesome
Ice, shining like the light of precious things.
Seated above it, in a throne above,
Is like the appearance of a human—[one must] marvel regarding what is said.
And every vision or apparition, according to the prophets,
And every story, according to the report of those who saw it—
Their mystical meaning is wondrous, partaking of the mystery of the soul.

content.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה יוי אֱלֹהִים דָּבָר כִּי אִם גָּלָה.
content.transliteration: Ki lo ya‘asé adonai Elohim davar ki im gala.
content.english: For Adonai, God, does not do anything without revealing [it].
The wondrousness of His word is formulated by His prophets.
Elevated and glorified be the One who is declared blessed, and is blessed.

content.hebrew: וּבָר֤וּךְ ׀ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹד֖וֹ אֶת־כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃ (תהלים עב:יט)
content.transliteration: Uvaruch shem kevodo le‘olam veyimmalé chevodo et kol ha’arets amen, ve’amen:
content.english: And blessed be His glorious name forever, and may his Glory fill the whole world. Amen and Amen! (Ps. 72:19)
Blessed be Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
